column1: # tests/suite-deps-candidates.tsv — HERD-575 SUITE-DEPS CANDIDATE LEDGER: advisory rows a PROVEN
# scope escape appends (scripts/herd/scope-escape.sh's herd_scope_escape_check, via the main-health
# red leg in scripts/herd/agent-watch.sh) — never a human, never anything gating. Each row maps a
# test the diff-scoped selection (HERD-532) MISSED to the changed path(s) whose sha later reded
# downstream, on a sha whose own gate had run scoped — the exact undeclared `# suite-deps:` coverage
# the miss proves. Rows are a WORKLIST, not a manifest: nothing reads this file to change gate
# behavior. A human/builder PROMOTES a row by adding the real `# suite-deps:` header line to the
# named test (see scripts/herd/suite-shard.sh) and then deleting the row here.
# Columns: test (comma-joined if more than one test missed the same escape) · changed_paths
# (';'-joined) · sha (the red sha the escape was proven on) · status (always 'candidate' until a
# human promotes/deletes the row — this file never sets any other value).
